q: Which grid emission factor should a Mexican supplier use?
title: Mexico grid factor for suppliers
short: Use the national electricity system emission factor published each year by Mexico's environment and energy authorities, for the year the power was used, and cite it. Recent figures are a little over 0.4 kg of CO2 per kWh, reflecting a gas heavy grid.
audience: Auto parts, steel and glass suppliers in Mexico answering buyer Scope 2 questions

ul: Location based Scope 2: the official national factor for the year.
Market based Scope 2: clean energy certificates or a supply contract meeting the Scope 2 Quality Criteria.
CBAM: for cement and fertilisers the electricity factor changes the cost; for steel and aluminium electricity is not charged.

p: Record the publication, its year and the value. Do not mix years in one report, and update when the new figure is out.

senseible: Senseible reads each site's monthly electricity bills into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 2 record. Grid factors outside India are entered from the official source for the country and year, and are labelled with that source.
